shortBio.en: Depeche Mode principal songwriter; guitar, keys, and backing vocals.
shortBio.zh: Depeche Mode 主要写歌人；吉他、键盘与和声。

body.en: Born 1961, Dagenham. Writes most Depeche Mode material after Vince Clarke leaves. Guitar and synth parts share space with Gahan’s lead vocal.
body.zh: 1961 年生于 Dagenham。Vince Clarke 离队后写大部分曲目。吉他与合成器与 Gahan 主唱并行。
